mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.semester_id, r.type, r.target_user_id, r.payload_json, r.status, r.batch_no, r.applicant_id, r.reason, r.created_at, r.review_at, t.name AS targetUserName, t.user_no AS targetUserNo, tc.name AS currentCollegeName, tcl.name AS currentClassName, a.name AS applicantName FROM change_request r JOIN sys_user t ON t.id = r.target_user_id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = r.applicant_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN college tc ON tc.id = t.college_id AND tc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN school_class tcl ON tcl.id = t.class_id AND tcl.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND r.status = #{status} AND r.batch_no = #{batchNo} AND r.type = #{type} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
